# The Curly Willow Eatery

> Seasonal lunch and dinner restaurant in downtown Collingwood, Ontario, near Blue Mountain.

The Curly Willow Eatery is a locally loved restaurant at 141 Pine Street, Collingwood, ON L9Y 2P1.
Owners Linda and Mike Sloat focus on fresh local ingredients, attentive service, and a warm intimate atmosphere.
Gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian options are available. Reservations are recommended.

## Key facts

- Address: 141 Pine Street, Collingwood, Ontario L9Y 2P1, Canada
- Phone: 705-444-1562
- Lunch: Wednesday–Friday 11:30–3:00
- Dinner: Tuesday–Saturday 5:00–9:00
- Closed: Sunday and Monday
- Private events, weddings, birthdays, office gatherings, and off-site catering available
- Website: https://thecurlywilloweatery.com/
